Redone properly this time: Europe PMC's API returns isOpenAccess:N and an empty/absent fullTextXML for PMID 36227281 (the primary paper for this GSE, Choudhury et al. 2023 Neuro-Oncology), so instead fetched pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10013643/ directly (browser user-agent) and got the real rendered HTML (confirmed by successfully extracting body text, not a CAPTCHA/login page). Searched it for every occurrence of 'correspond' and for author-footnote markers: there is exactly one author-notes entry, reading verbatim 'Corresponding Author: David R. Raleigh, MD, PhD, Associate Professor, Departments of Radiation Oncology and Neurological Surgery, University of California San Francisco, 1450 3rd Street, HD481, San Francisco, CA 94158, USA (david.raleigh@ucsf.edu).', with a single '✉' marker in the byline next to Raleigh's name only -- Choudhury (first author) carries no such marker. This is a direct quote from the paper's own correspondence footnote, not an inference from author-list position, so corresponding_author is changed to 'David R Raleigh' (Choudhury dropped) with high confidence this time, unlike the previous unexplained edit. Also cross-checked GEO's own Series_contact_name for GSE212666, which lists William Chen (UCSF) as the metadata-submission contact -- included here for transparency but explicitly NOT used to set corresponding_author, since GEO's submission contact is a different role from the paper's corresponding author and this project's standard requires verifying against the paper's own footnote.
